answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in escrow, while evidence of coordinated equivocation links identities into a single fault set. If k identities sign conflicting histories, the protocol applies O(k^2) slashing, and detecting a managed sybil swarm adds an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation. Splitting stake across saffron, shale, or pigment aliases therefore cannot dilute accountability: correlation dominates any gain.
